| CPRD code | Recorded term |

| `J1017` | Eosinophilic oesophagitis |
| `^ESCT1165474` | Food-induced eosinophilic oesophagitis |
| `^ESCTEO508265` | Eosinophilic esophagitis |
| `^ESCTEO508286` | Eosinophilic ulcer of oesophagus |

Nonspecific oesophagitis, eosinophilia, and eosinophilic disease at other anatomical sites are excluded because they do not establish eosinophilic esophagitis.
